title: eve-d-gusts-boat
summary: Gusts reworked as patches of ripples on glassy water, ripples only from a Ripples group, a 3 m wavelength floor, crest sharpening in the sea and per group, boat tuning multipliers with a planing drag taper, hull drag at 0.8, the Swell City classic sea and new Gorge starts.
problem: Gusts roughened the whole sea and warped the ripples; ripples appeared even when no Ripples group was on; the shortest wind-sea components flickered; crest sharpening was a global lighting slider that also changed the boat; the boat could not scoot above 10 mph and the Gorge starts were in the wrong places.
implemented: Gusts are patches of ripples: glass between them (or the Ripples group's own wind), rougher water inside. They are measured from the camera (a slider change never re-rolls the scene) and wander at the new Patch drift speed, apart from the gust wind. Veer is gone.
Ripples show only from a Ripples group (or under gusts); an empty sea is glass.
Wind sea and chop components stop at 3 m wavelength; the fine chop layer takes over from there.
Crest sharpening belongs to the sea (default 2) with a multiplier on each wave group. The shader and the CPU wave field agree.
Settings, Boat tuning: surf push, hull drag, paddle efficiency, mass, broaching, turn rate, turn drag, pearling and Planing (1 = off, 2 = about half the drag off by 16 mph). Saved in links and clips.
Hull drag of the three paddlers is 0.8 of before: flat-water speeds are about 0.5 mph higher at the same power.
Seas: Shilshole "Undulating - smooth" and Gorge "Swell City classic". Starts: The Hatchery and Drano added, Swell City, Bob's Beach and Viento moved to Mike's coordinates.
The map can be dragged by its title bar and resized from its corner, and starts lower left.
Fixes: a crash when the sea had no wind sea; the Distant land and Crest sharpening settings were removed.
review: Gorge, Swell City, the "Swell City classic" sea: Chase and Boyan cameras; try Planing 1 / 2 / 3 and Surf push in Boat tuning.
A sea with only a Gusts group (glass with patches), then add a Ripples group.
Drag the map and resize it; reload to see it remembered.
Shilshole, "Undulating - smooth" on the Elite ski at high power.

questions.text: Do the gust patches read as ripples popping in, drifting and leaving over glass?
Is the Patch drift default (0.8 m/s) about right? (1 = too fast, 5 = too slow)
Does Planing 2 give believable speeds above 10 mph without making the ski too grabby?
Does the flat-water pace at 160 W (now about 7.0 mph for Advanced) feel right?
Anything in Swell City classic that is wrong (positions, wave heights, the reverb)?

known: Pearling into the wave ahead is still rare (worklist G-039).
Easing off the roller train east of the Hatchery and a Tunnel 5 reverb are not in the sea.
The Hatchery and Drano starts reuse the Swell City heading and wind; points and headings are read from the map, not surveyed.
